product.outcome: Rent the tool you need from a neighbor this weekend.

users.who: A renter on a phone on Saturday morning, with two minutes to find a nearby tool.
A neighbor listing a tool and arranging pickup in a message thread from a phone or laptop; lender approval is outside this round.

capabilities.note: A hosted provider owns collection of payment details and reports the acknowledged result.

populated.label: Populated
populated.rule: Home shows current rentals and nearby tools; catalog shows comparable tool names, daily fees and distances. Each surface reads only the contracts in its own slots.

homeFirstVisit.label: First visit
homeFirstVisit.rule: Offer browsing before a rental exists; do not fabricate recent activity.

loading.label: Loading
loading.rule: Keep previously loaded tool rows while refreshing nearby tools. Home also retains current rentals; catalog does not render the Rental contract. Announce the local loading status without replacing retained content.

homeLongContent.label: Long content
homeLongContent.rule: Wrap long tool names and pickup instructions without obscuring due dates.

noMatches.label: No matches
noMatches.rule: No Tool rows match the current nearby-search criteria. Home keeps current Rental rows and offers browsing a wider area; catalog preserves its criteria and offers clearing filters.

catalogNoTools.label: No tools
catalogNoTools.rule: No tools are available in the current area; offer a real wider-area search.

failed.label: Failed
failed.rule: No Tool or Rental rows are available after the request fails. Keep route and search context, show the surface-specific recovery copy and offer a load retry without private diagnostics.

catalogLongContent.label: Long content
catalogLongContent.rule: Long tool names wrap; fee, distance and actions stay readable.

toolDetailAvailable.label: Available
toolDetailAvailable.rule: Show daily fee, availability and lender before requesting a rental.

toolDetailRequestPending.label: Request pending
toolDetailRequestPending.rule: Keep the tool and chosen dates visible; prevent duplicate requests.

toolDetailRequestSent.label: Request sent
toolDetailRequestSent.rule: Confirm the saved request; do not imply the lender has approved it.

toolDetailRequestFailed.label: Request failed
toolDetailRequestFailed.rule: Preserve dates and explain that no request was saved.

toolDetailUnavailable.label: Unavailable
toolDetailUnavailable.rule: Keep the tool name, photo and lender identity for a tool already rented; hide the daily-fee offer and request/date controls, and offer nearby alternatives.

toolDetailLenderAway.label: Lender away
toolDetailLenderAway.rule: Keep the tool and lender identity while the lender is not accepting requests; hide the daily-fee offer and request/date controls, and show another browse route.

toolDetailLongContent.label: Long content
toolDetailLongContent.rule: Wrap full tool names and lender notes without hiding price or dates.

checkoutReady.label: Ready
checkoutReady.rule: Show final daily fee, duration and total before leaving for hosted payment.

checkoutHandoffPending.label: Handoff pending
checkoutHandoffPending.rule: Keep the rental identity and avoid a second payment handoff.

checkoutDeclined.label: Declined
checkoutDeclined.rule: Keep the rental request; the provider reports no charge was made.

checkoutUnknownResult.label: Unknown result
checkoutUnknownResult.rule: Do not invite another charge while payment status is unreconciled.

checkoutReturnedWithoutPaying.label: Returned without paying
checkoutReturnedWithoutPaying.rule: Keep the approved rental and offer a new provider handoff.

checkoutLongContent.label: Long content
checkoutLongContent.rule: Show long rental identity and fee terms without collapsing the final total.

receiptConfirmed.label: Confirmed
receiptConfirmed.rule: Show the acknowledged payment reference and approved pickup details.

receiptEmailPending.label: Email pending
receiptEmailPending.rule: Payment success is independent of email delivery; receipt remains revisitable.

receiptLongContent.label: Long content
receiptLongContent.rule: Wrap long tool names and pickup instructions in the durable receipt.

rentalsActive.label: Upcoming and active
rentalsActive.rule: Upcoming and active rentals lead; due dates are explicit.

rentalsEmpty.label: Empty
rentalsEmpty.rule: No rental exists; provide the browse-tools starting route.

rentalsCancellationPending.label: Cancellation pending
rentalsCancellationPending.rule: Keep the rental visible and prevent a second cancellation.

rentalsCancelled.label: Cancelled
rentalsCancelled.rule: The acknowledged cancellation remains in history; the lender has been notified.

rentalsCancellationFailed.label: Cancellation failed
rentalsCancellationFailed.rule: The rental is still active; keep the confirm context and offer safe retry.

rentalsFailed.label: Failed
rentalsFailed.rule: Do not fabricate due dates or rental status; offer a load retry.

rentalsLongContent.label: Long content
rentalsLongContent.rule: Wrap long tool names and pickup notes while keeping due dates visible.

threadPopulated.label: Populated
threadPopulated.rule: Keep authors and times explicit; messages remain tied to the rental.

threadSending.label: Sending
threadSending.rule: Keep the draft and distinguish the unsent message from acknowledged messages.

threadFailed.label: Failed
threadFailed.rule: Retain the message draft and offer an explicit resend.

threadEmpty.label: Empty
threadEmpty.rule: A new rental thread has no messages; offer a named composer.

threadLongContent.label: Long content
threadLongContent.rule: Wrap long pickup instructions and message bodies in readable order.

settingsReady.label: Ready
settingsReady.rule: Display saved preferences in two clear sections.

settingsSaving.label: Saving
settingsSaving.rule: Keep preferences visible while they are being saved.

settingsSaved.label: Saved
settingsSaved.rule: Acknowledge the saved values in place.

settingsFailed.label: Failed
settingsFailed.rule: Retain unsaved values and explain how to retry.

signInAddressEntry.label: Address entry
signInAddressEntry.rule: Ask for an email address without displaying another person’s rentals.

signInCodeSent.label: Code sent
signInCodeSent.rule: Explain delivery and allow code paste into one labelled field.

signInVerifying.label: Verifying
signInVerifying.rule: Keep the entered code visible and prevent duplicate verification.

signInExpired.label: Expired
signInExpired.rule: Explain code expiry and allow a fresh code without losing the intended route.

signInFailed.label: Failed
signInFailed.rule: Keep the email address and offer a new code or exit.

notFoundMissingDestination.label: Missing destination
notFoundMissingDestination.rule: Explain the missing address without implying a rental was deleted or a payment failed.

emailRentalConfirmedReady.label: Ready
emailRentalConfirmedReady.rule: Send only after the hosted provider acknowledges payment; include the saved rental reference, pickup and return dates, lender name and receipt destination.

pushRequestApprovedReady.label: Ready
pushRequestApprovedReady.rule: Notify the renter only after the lender acknowledges approval; name the lender and tool and open the unpaid approved rental for review.

lendToolDraft.label: Draft
lendToolDraft.rule: Render editable tool name, photo, daily fee, availability and care notes with the lender’s own identity attached; keep the draft until an explicit save succeeds.

lendToolSaved.label: Saved
lendToolSaved.rule: Show the saved tool identity and daily fee with a route to its tool details; neighbors can request it only when its availability is available.

lendToolFailed.label: Failed
lendToolFailed.rule: Retain lending-form values when saving fails.

lendToolLongContent.label: Long content
lendToolLongContent.rule: Allow complete tool names and care notes in the lending form.

signInVerified.label: Signed in
signInVerified.rule: Acknowledge verified email possession and offer continuation to the saved rental destination; do not ask for the code again.

lendToolSaving.label: Saving
lendToolSaving.rule: Keep the lending draft visible, disable another save and wait for persistence to acknowledge the tool.

rentalsHistory.label: Rental history
rentalsHistory.rule: Show pending, approved, active, returned and cancelled rentals with their acknowledged status; cancellation is available only on eligible pre-pickup rentals.

emailRentalConfirmedLong.label: Long rental details
emailRentalConfirmedLong.rule: Wrap the paid rental’s full tool identity and pickup instructions in the email without separating dates from the receipt link.

pushRequestApprovedLong.label: Long tool name
pushRequestApprovedLong.rule: Wrap the approved tool’s full identity and retain the review action; the notification is approval, not a payment receipt.

threadSent.label: Message sent
threadSent.rule: Add the acknowledged message to this rental’s thread, clear only the submitted draft and keep the composer available.

signInSendingCode.label: Sending code
signInSendingCode.rule: Keep the email identifier visible and disable another code request until the email service acknowledges the send.

signInDeliveryFailed.label: Code delivery failed
signInDeliveryFailed.rule: Keep the entered email and intended rental destination; explain that the code request failed and offer a new request or another address.

flows.goal: Sign in when needed and find the first tool to rent.
flows.ends: The renter reaches a usable home and can browse nearby tools.

flows.goal: Sign in without a password and return to the intended rental.

binding.because: Shed has no password credential; email possession is the chosen proof method.

flows.ends: The identity is verified and the intended task can resume.

flows.goal: Find the right nearby tool and send a rental request.
flows.ends: The saved request appears in rentals with pending approval.

flows.goal: Pay the approved rental with the hosted provider and keep the receipt.

binding.because: The payment provider owns collection of payment details; Shed owns the total and return-status reconciliation.

flows.ends: The acknowledged payment has a saved receipt, independent of confirmation-email delivery.

flows.goal: Cancel a rental before pickup and know the lender was told.

binding.because: Cancellation notifies the lender immediately and cannot be undone.

flows.ends: The rental history acknowledges cancellation and lender notification.

flows.goal: Agree pickup details with the lender.
flows.ends: The acknowledged message is visible in the rental thread.

flows.goal: Read the lender’s approval and review the rental before paying.
flows.ends: The approved rental and payment action are available from the notification.

flows.goal: Choose a normal search area, pickup window and rental notification channels.
flows.ends: The saved search, pickup and notification values remain visible and apply to later tool searches and rental updates.

flows.goal: Recover from an unknown tool or rental address.
flows.ends: The renter reaches nearby tools or their rental list without changing any rental or payment.

flows.goal: Find the paid rental’s reference, dates and pickup instructions in its confirmation email.
flows.ends: The email opens the durable paid rental receipt, even when the original payment tab is gone.

flows.goal: Notice that the lender approved a requested tool and review the unpaid rental.
flows.ends: The approval notification opens the saved rental with its dates and hosted-payment action available.

flows.goal: Offer a tool to neighbors with its daily fee and care notes.

binding.because: A tool’s care notes and rental terms need an explicit editor page.

flows.ends: The lender’s saved tool details show its daily fee, care notes and availability, and the tool can be found by neighbors when available.

surfaces.question: Is a pickup or rental request waiting for me, or should I find a nearby tool?
What can I rent near me?

binding.because: Tool shape and condition merit an image-led preview; distance remains visible.

surfaces.question: Is this the right tool, and can I get it Saturday?

slots.because: Optional care notes fit one in-flow details region; essential price and dates remain outside it.
The request has no measured total; an indeterminate local status is honest.

surfaces.question: What will I pay before handing off to the payment provider?

slots.because: Provider handoff has no measured progress total.

surfaces.question: Did payment work, and what happens before pickup?
What have I rented, and when is it due back?

slots.because: Cancellation result must persist alongside rental history, not only in a transient toast.

surfaces.question: What did the lender say about this rental?
What search distance and pickup window suit me, and how should Shed notify me about rentals?

binding.because: Six preferences fit one sectioned page with an explicit save boundary.

surfaces.question: How do I prove my identity and return to this rental?

binding.because: Shed uses possession of email and has no password sign-in.

surfaces.question: Is this address missing, and which route gets me back to nearby tools or my unchanged rentals?

binding.because: This address does not identify an existing tool or rental.

surfaces.question: Which tool have I paid for, when is pickup and return, and where can I reopen the receipt?
Which lender approved my tool request, and where can I review the dates before paying?
What tool, daily fee and care notes am I offering, and is it currently available to neighbors?

axes.question: How should renters and lenders agree a pickup time?
axes.why: A rental can be paid while the exact handoff time still needs a conversation.

options.label: Arrange in messages
options.note: Dates are saved, and the lender confirms the handoff time in the rental thread.

options.label: Choose a pickup window
options.note: The lender supplies available windows before the request; messages remain for directions.
